title: Equipment rental rates
summary: What rental companies publish for chippers, bucket trucks and lifts. Thin on trucks: most forestry-truck renters quote by phone.

facts.claim: Sunbelt Rentals' Spring Valley NY branch (12.5 miles from Peekskill) rents a 12-inch, 85 HP diesel chipper for $430 a day, $1,450 a week and $3,525 for four weeks, pickup.

source.name: Sunbelt Rentals — 12 Inch Wood Chipper (live rate card, Spring Valley NY branch #785, pickup)

facts.caveat: Online rate for the dates 9/21–9/22/2026. Rates vary by branch and date.

facts.claim: Same branch, same day: 34-ft towable boom $435 / $1,230 / $3,090; 50-ft towable boom $590 / $1,520 / $3,600; 65-ft telescopic boom lift $715 / $1,575 / $3,570 (day / week / four weeks).

source.name: Sunbelt Rentals — site search results priced for Spring Valley NY branch #785

facts.caveat: Boom lifts, not bucket trucks. Useful for pricing structure, not as a truck comparison.

facts.claim: All Points Equipment (Palmetto FL, rents nationwide) lists a 60-ft forestry bucket truck with an 11-ft debris body, under-CDL, at $750 a day and $3,500 a week; monthly is 'call'.

source.name: All Points Equipment — 2025 60FT Forestry Bucket Truck For Rent UNDER CDL

facts.caveat: Listing dated May 2024 and not local to New York.

facts.claim: Forestry Rentals (Brownstown IL) lists a 55-ft forestry bucket truck at $2,500 a week and $6,900 a month, with no daily rate. Class B CDL required (33,000 lb truck).

source.name: Forestry Rentals — Forestry Bucket Truck Rental

facts.caveat: Page carries no date. Not local.

facts.claim: We found no rental company that publishes a chip truck rate. Custom Truck One Source, TRL Rents and Tree Trucks rent forestry trucks but are quote-only. Sunbelt's search near Peekskill returned boom lifts, not bucket or chip trucks.

facts.caveat: A phone quote from Custom Truck (833-305-7368) or a local dealer would close this gap.

facts.claim: Aggregator sites quote bucket trucks at $300–$770 a day and 42–60 ft trucks around $3,250 a month. These are Tier 4 sources with no primary data behind them and are not relied on.
facts.caveat: Recorded so nobody re-discovers these and treats them as fact.
